Package midtermlabproject2

package midtermlabproject2
  • Class
    Description
    InfixToPostfix
    Converts an infix expression to postfix using a LinkedStack of operators and the incoming/in-stack priority (icp/isp) scheme from Module 3.
    InvalidExpressionException
    Thrown when an infix expression cannot be converted or a postfix expression cannot be evaluated.
    LinkedStack<T>
    Linked-list implementation of Stack (Module 3).
    Main
    Menu-based console application for infix to postfix conversion and postfix evaluation.
    Node<T>
    Singly linked node used by LinkedStack (Module 3).
    PostfixEvaluator
    Evaluates a space-separated postfix expression using a LinkedStack of operands (Module 3).
    Row
    One row of a trace table, holding one string per column.
    Stack<T>
    Stack abstract data type (Module 3).
    StackException
    Thrown when a stack operation is invalid, for example popping or peeking an empty stack.
    TablePrinter
    Utility class that prints a trace table in the console using +---+ style borders.
